verses.en: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.sm: Ierusalema. O le salamó o le nuu O le avega o le afioga a le ALII ia Isaraelu; o loo fetalai mai le ALII le ua faamafolafola le lagi, ma faavaeina le lalolagi, na ia faia foi le agaga o le tagata i totonu ia te ia;

verses.en: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
verses.sm: faauta, o a‘u lava’ ou te faia Ierusalema ma ipu e tautevateva ai nuu uma o vagavagai; e i ai foi ia Iuta pe a vagaia Ierusalema.

verses.en: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.sm: O lea aso foi ou te fai ai lerusalema ma maa mamafa i nuu uma; atoa uma o e sii i ai, e matuà manunua ai i latou; a e faapotopotoina nuu uma lava o le lalolagi latou te tau.

verses.en: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai le ALII, O le aso lava lea ou te taia ai solofanua uma i le atuatuvale, ma e o tietie ai i le faavalemalosi; a o le aiga o Iuta, ou te vaavaai lava iai; o solofanua uma a nuu ou te taia ia i le tauaso.

verses.en: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
verses.sm: O alii o Iuta latou te faapea i o latou loto, E fai moʻu malosi o e nonofo i lerusalema i le ALII o ‘au lo latou Atua.

verses.en: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O le aso lea ou te faia ai o alii o Iuta e pei o le taigaafi i laau, e pei o le sulu foi ua mu i le fusi saito; latou te faaumatia nuu uma e siosio mai i le itu taumatau ma le itu tauagavale; e toe mau: foi Ierusalema i lona lava nuu o Ierusalema.

verses.en: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
verses.sm: E faaolaina foi e le ALII o fale ie o Iuta, e muamua lava, ina ia le faasilisili le viiga o le aiga o Tavita, ma le viiga o e nonofo i Ierusalema ia Iuta.

verses.en: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
verses.sm: O lea aso e faamamalu mai ai le ALII i e o nonofo i Ierusalema; o so latou ua vaivai i lea aso e pei o Tavita ia; o le aiga o Tavita, e pei o le Atua ia, e pei o le agelu a le ALII i o latou luma.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O lea aso foi ou te saili ai ia faaumatia nuu uma lava o e O mai e tau ma Ierusalema.

verses.en: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verses.sm: Ou te liligi ifo i luga o le aiga o Tavita, ma luga o e nonofo i Ierusalema le agaga o le alofa tunoa ma talosaga, latou te vaavaai mai ia te au na latou u4a; latou te 13II tagitu'i foi ia te ia, e pei ona tagitu‘iile atalii e toatasi, ma latou faanoanoa ia te ia, e pei ona faanoanoa i le ulumatua.

verses.en: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.sm: O lea aso e tele ai le taufaitagitu‘i i Ierusalema, e pei o le tagitu‘i i Atatarimoni i le vanu o Mekito.

verses.en: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.sm: E taufaitagitu‘i le nuu e tagi a aiga; o le aiga o sa Tavità, na o i latou, ma a latou ava, ua na o i latou; o le aiga o sa Nataná, na o i latou, ma a latou ava, na o i latou;

verses.en: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.sm: 0 le aiga o sa Levi, ua na o i latou, ma a latou avā, na o i latou; o le aiga o Semi, na o i latou, ma a latou avā, na o i latou.

verses.en: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.sm: O aiga uma o e totoe, o aiga taitasi na o i latou, ma a latou ava na o i latou.
